rationale: Verified input sets are l-infinity bounded polytopes (velocity bounds; CV task 'robust to perturbations within 2/256 l-infinity'); CLR-1 applies only to closed-loop reachability.
Lipschitz tolerance (Lemma 3.1) only accelerates re-verifying the same per-step input-set spec; no plant model, no larger scope or modality reached.
Coverage theorem rests on unverifiable dispersive-noise assumption, not a sound certificate on the model; headline coverage is shown on real data (CIFAR-10H, AVA, MS COCO).
Theorem 1 bounds training-time worst-class empirical loss under assumed mistake bound; no guarantee on the learned model's robustness, which is only PGD/AutoAttack-evaluated.
Certified accuracy is evaluated on GTSRB traffic-sign recognition (Table 2), a perception task of an autonomous vehicle; tier A needs any vehicle-task evaluation.
Reach-avoid certificate (Theorem 1) covers polynomial dynamics and a non-learned sampling controller; the SVM safe set is used as given, its correctness never guaranteed.
